short_description: Original IMAX. 70mm horizontal film with 15 perforations per frame. Scan-equivalent ~8.8K–11.7K, photochemical grain, 1.43:1 — highest-information commercial cinema format ever deployed.

default_projection.effective_resolution_label: ~8.8K–11.7K scan-equivalent (8µm–6µm scan; no authoritative single figure); grain limits perceived detail before resolution does
default_projection.contrast_notes: Photochemical contrast ~4,500:1 measured optically. Wide dynamic range from emulsion chemical latitude — not digital HDR metadata. hdr field is 'photochemical' to distinguish from 'none' (no DR advantage).
default_projection.color_gamut: Photochemical (very wide, not specifiable as % DCI-P3)

known_limitations: Requires physical film print — very few commercial bookings per year globally
Film grain and print quality vary; duplication generations affect perceived sharpness
Print carries 6-channel magnetic soundtrack; modern 12.1 IMAX audio available in equipped venues via separate system
